negative_findings.description: No evidence found of an active Montenegrin startup-specific press-release wire or a national fintech-association newsroom that aggregates non-bank payment announcements. ICT Cortex is the closest substitute but is an ICT cluster, not a payments body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sr and en surfaced only general tech portals (Digitalizuj.Me, itspot.me) and the ICT Cortex blog; no dedicated fintech PR channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must rely on per-company crawling plus media relays, which raises miss-risk for very small launches.

negative_findings.description: Searched for regional challenger wallets (Aircash, KEKS Pay, Revolut, Monesa) entering or announcing Montenegro; results returned Croatian-market coverage only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Montenegro-specific launch, licensing or press announcement for these wallets was found in this run — absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Regional-challenger entry would be a major disruption vector for merchant acceptance; the gap should be closed by checking the CBCG e-money/payment-institution registers and each wallet's own newsroom directly.

negative_findings.description: Local-language coverage for merchant-side software was thin on some concepts: no established Montenegrin term surfaced for 'softPOS'/'tap-to-phone', and searches on 'QR plaćanje' returned mostly Serbian (RS) fiscal-receipt content rather than Montenegrin merchant QR schemes.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr queries on QR/merchant acceptance leaked heavily into the Serbian market; no ME-specific merchant QR scheme identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query glossary needs ME-specific disambiguators ('Crna Gora', '.me', 'CBCG', 'Podgorica') and English-in-local terms ('softPOS', 'tap to phone') to avoid RS/HR contamination.

negative_findings.description: The only funding-data aggregator found for ME fintech (Tracxn) lists ~102 entities dominated by forex/CFD and crypto shells domiciled in Montenegro (AMarkets, GANNMarkets, GoDefi, Impact, Prosecure) rather than domestic payment challengers.
negative_findings.result_summary: High entity count, low relevance density; only ~10 reported as funded.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive use of the aggregator would badly distort the ME fintech actor map; every entry needs cross-validation against CBCG registers.

negative_findings.description: Several company homepages were inferred from organisation names rather than confirmed by a fetch in this run: logate.com, fleka.me, tehnopolis.me, and the 2bi.me root.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs provided with moderate confidence; only prestopay.me was fetched directly this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as stable collection targets.

coverage_gaps.description: The full roster of CBCG-licensed non-bank payment institutions, e-money institutions, registered AISPs and their agents was not enumerated — only Presto and (per its own claim) 2bi/Digitalni Kiosk were identified by name.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse the three CBCG registers (payment institutions, e-money institutions, withdrawn authorisations), then run a company-site/press sweep per licensed entity.

coverage_gaps.description: App-store release-note history was identified as a source type but only for Digitalni Kiosk; no systematic ME-storefront sweep of payment/wallet apps (Presto, bank apps, parking/transit apps, crypto wallets) was performed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an ME App Store / Google Play watchlist keyed by developer and category, polling version + release notes weekly.

coverage_gaps.description: Merchant-side POS/ISV landscape only partially mapped (eFiskal, Sekas, Pošta CG PostFiskal, Telekom AdeoPOS/Pantheon). The Tax Administration's list of approved e-fiscalisation software providers was not located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and crawl the Poreska uprava / eFiskalizacija register of certified fiscalisation software vendors to enumerate every ISV touching Montenegrin merchants.

coverage_gaps.description: No Albanian-language coverage attempted, despite a significant Albanian-speaking population in Ulcinj/Tuzi where merchant-facing marketing may run in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian query set (portofol digjital, pagesa me celular, Mali i Zi) in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Funding-round announcements for Montenegrin payment startups were not found for any period; it is unclear whether none occurred or whether they are simply not published in indexed sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check the Startup Index Crne Gore 2026 report roster and Game Changer Montenegro / Investment Agency announcements, plus CRPS ownership changes, to detect unpublicised raises.

brief: Montenegro's non-bank payments scene is small and highly concentrated: two named challengers dominate the public record — PrestoPay (first CBCG-licensed PSD2 payment institution, Oct 2024, with multibanking, P2P and QR bill payment) and 2bi's Digitalni Kiosk (positioned as the country's first wallet, ~60k users, parking/top-up/biller rails). Because these players publish no regulatory filings, the earliest signals live in three channels: their own sites and app-store release notes, the CBCG payment-institution and e-money registers (which enumerate licensed challengers before any press coverage), and a thin local media/cluster layer (Digitalizuj.Me, Bankar.me, RTCG, ICT Cortex's Fintech Committee, NTP's Startup Index). The merchant-facing layer is a separate, under-mapped cohort of e-fiscalisation/POS ISVs (eFiskal, Sekas, Pošta CG PostFiskal, Telekom's AdeoPOS bundle) where card-acceptance and QR integrations are actually decided. Main risks to collection: sr-language queries leak heavily into Serbian and Croatian markets, several vendors announce only on LinkedIn/Facebook behind login walls, and the one available startup aggregator is dominated by forex/crypto shells domiciled in Montenegro rather than genuine domestic payment challengers.
